verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents Replit's own built-in hosting and publishing: production deployments at a Replit URL, access settings, and custom domains that still point to Replit-hosted apps. Nothing documents exporting or deploying the generated app to an external host or self-managed infrastructure. A community mention of local git commits describes a user-side activity, not a documented external-deploy capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure
